enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Pull blanket over body. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Breathe deeply. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket up. Lie on back. Snore. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Lie still.

Turn on bathroom light. Use toilet. Wash hands. Turn on tap. Pick up soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Turn off bathroom light.

Walk into kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cupboard. Take out bowl and cereal. Close cupboard. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Finish eating. Pick up bowl and spoon. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl and spoon. Place in dishwasher. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Lay clothes on bed. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Put on pants. Zip pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press button. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to office.

Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open document. Type report. Answer phone. Talk on phone. Attend meeting. Take notes. Return to desk. Print document. Pick up printout. Staple pages. File document. Make phone call. Write notes.

Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Choose food. Pay for food. Carry tray to table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Talk with colleague. Finish eating. Clear tray. Walk outside. Walk around block. Return to office. Sit at desk. Check phone.

Open computer. Check email. Read new emails. Reply to emails. Open spreadsheet. Enter data. Save spreadsheet. Attend conference call. Speak on call. Take notes. Open document. Edit document. Save document. Print document. Pick up printout. Review printout. Make corrections. File document. Organize desk. Write to-do list.

Leave office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk home. Enter house. Close door. Take off shoes. Hang coat. Put bag down.

Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and chicken. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Chop chicken. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Pick up plate. Place in dishwasher. Turn off light.

Walk into living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on couch. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put phone down. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out water. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Drink water. Put water on table. Turn off TV.

Walk into bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Sit at desk. Open computer. Turn on computer. Log in. Open browser. Check social media. Open email. Reply to personal emails. Open document. Write personal project. Save document. Open game. Play game. Check phone. Reply to text. Close game. Turn off computer. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Wash face. Pick up towel. Dry face with towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk into bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read more. Close book. Put book down. Turn off desk lamp. Lie on bed. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Turn to left side.

Lie on bed. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Breathe. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket up. Lie on back. Snore. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping.
